name: Distractions
overview: Scripture reveals that distractions often come as temptations that seek to draw us away from God's commands, as seen when Jesus was led into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil (Matthew 4:1). The call to meditate day and night on God's law (Joshua 1:8; Psalms 119:15) and to have our words and thoughts acceptable to the Lord (Psalms 19:14) highlights the importance of focused devotion to overcome distractions. Furthermore, the promise that no weapon formed against God's servants shall prosper (Isaiah 54:17) assures believers of divine protection amid spiritual opposition, while the warning in Genesis 4:7 reminds us that sin lies ready at the door, urging vigilance and self-control to rule over temptation.
